title: Figure 13. Quantum Back Action as a Mechanism for Creating the Standard Quantum Limit
description: Two-panel diagram labeled "TIME t = 0" and "TIME t = dt", each showing a blue circle ("Position x of mass m being measured") with uncertainty markers Δx(0), Δp(0) > ħ/2Δx(0) and Δx(dt). A large curved purple arrow labeled "Quantum Back Action: x(dt) measurement affected by earlier x(0) measurement" links the panels; yellow callouts read "Measurement of x drives down Δx(0) which drives up Δp(0)" and "Therefore Δp(0) drives up Δx(dt)". Text includes equation (4) and begins "Calculating the Standard Quantum Limit (SQL)".
